title: Albumin–hemoglobin interaction does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: Adding a serum albumin-by-hemoglobin product to flexible additive routine predictors did not establish improved concurrent log-hsCRP prediction: source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.000234; frozen-source second-cycle weighted gain 0.000533 ln(mg/L)² (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.002959, 0.003623]). This is retrospective NHANES cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched or non-NHANES validation. Source n=4204; target n=3954; target baseline/augmented MSE 0.724491/0.723959. The registered success criterion failed. A limited negative/inconclusive predictive test, not evidence against inflammatory anemia biology or a clinical tool. AI-authored existing-public-data computation.
